---
description: Write the DBML file of the inferred schema.
title: ichnos dbml
---

`ichnos dbml` writes the tables, columns, keys, relationships and lineage that the corpus implies, as one DBML file.
Every claim carries its evidence counts, and every ambiguity lists its candidates.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("dbml", "--help")
```

## Example

The example reads one query file, so the schema stays short; a folder gives the schema of every query in it.

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("dbml", "queries/045_create_order_line_facts.sql")
```
